git_log_corroborating_commit.note_chronology: 14:28:49+05:00 == 09:28:49 UTC, which is ~85 minutes after the Fixed event's created_at (2026-07-28 08:03:46 UTC) -- chronologically consistent with a tracker-close-then-build-deploy sequence, though this is a single commit whose subject names BOTH ATM-953 and ATM-954, so per-item commit attribution here would itself trigger data-model.md's COMMIT_ATTRIBUTION_BY_GREP data-quality flag if a future implementer attributed the whole commit's diff to ATM-953 alone.

data_quality_observation_not_fabricated.detail: item_history row id=869 (Reopened) carries on_date='2026-07-28' but created_at='2026-08-05 11:30:17' -- an 8-day gap between the claimed event date and the DB write time. Per CT-003 (contract), a span between two db_write instants must never be presented as `elapsed`; per data-model.md's DATE_ONLY_RESOLUTION / RETROACTIVE_REGISTRATION flags, this exact on_date-vs-created_at discrepancy is the class of defect the flag exists to surface. This fixture does NOT resolve which of the two dates is the 'true' event time -- that determination, and whichever flag applies, is left to cycle_report.py's own CT-005 implementation to classify, per §11.4.6 (no-guessing: this RED-test author does not invent the resolution).

honest_gap_deferred_to_T042.statement: This fixture supplies REAL, citable item_history rows (Opened/Updated/Updated/Fixed/Reopened) plus ONE corroborating git commit for ATM-953. It does NOT attempt a full mapping of these onto all 11 data-model.md §1.1 stages (intake, investigation, implementation, test_authoring, gate_runs, build, review_rounds, fix_rounds, commit_push, deployment, manual_qa_wait) -- that full hand-verification, cross-referencing git log/builds.tsv/qa-results mtimes/agent_registry.jsonl/review-round records per stage, is tasks.md's own T042 ("Hand-verify the stage figures of ≥3 items (ATM-953 plus two more) from raw artefacts and diff them against cycle_report.py output; store the diff under qa-results/fastcycle/us1/handverify/"), a SEPARATE LATER task in this same User Story. Per §11.4.6 (no-guessing), this file does not fabricate a plausible-looking per-stage timestamp table where none has yet been hand-verified.

honest_gap_deferred_to_T042.stage_count_consistency_note_2026-10-03: The two lists directly above are keyed on CITABLE SOURCE IN THIS FIXTURE (8 stages have none, 3 have partial source) -- a DIFFERENT axis from how many of the 11 data-model.md stages cycle_report.py's own code can EVER measure regardless of input. Confirmed directly against cycle/cycle_report.py (S12-remediation round, 2026-10-03): 9 stages are ALWAYS UNMEASURED by the tool -- intake, investigation, implementation, test_authoring, gate_runs, build, fix_rounds, deployment, manual_qa_wait (build included: the F11.3 fix corrected its missing_instrument wording, it did NOT give it an elapsed-time instrument) -- while only commit_push (git-log grep, always attempted) and review_rounds (T034 review-record/v1, opt-in via --review-records-dir) can EVER be measured. 'build' therefore sits in THIS fixture's 'partial citable source' bucket (it has a corroborating commit subject line) while ALSO being one of the tool's 9 always-unmeasured stages -- the two counts (8 vs 9) are not in conflict, they are counting different things, and this note exists so a future reader does not read them as a contradiction.
